reading_issues: Single-file JPG (994x840 SnowPilot export). Hardness bar edges and layer boundaries measured from pixels against the axis ticks; boundaries are integer cm (outline rows at 74.1, 54.0, 41.1, 11.0, 10.1 and 8.1 cm). Temperature axis spans about -22.8 to 0 degC with ticks every 2 degC (18.86 px/degC). The top temperature dot (about 76 cm, -21 degC) is partly covered by the SnowPilot logo, so its height is +-0.5 cm and temperature +-0.3 degC. Surface-form glyph "+r" read as rimed PP (PPrm); surface_grain "PP" rests on that reading. Header is sparse (elevation, air temperature, precipitation, aspect, slope and PF/PS all blank). The CTN arrow sits at the ground of the tests column (no failure height). The red line at 11 cm is the problematic-layer flag. Chart title reads "Goat's Eye Profile".
